purpose: Record the cleanup of earlier directional-face references and iterative candidates before the compact frontal-face rotation generator is used.
removed_assets: legacy left profile and rear-hair references
observations: The 50-degree left front-quarter candidate was human approved before the reference-pack cleanup.
The rear-hair candidate was human approved before the reference-pack cleanup.
The earlier right-profile candidate was rejected.
Repeated angle-specific prompts accumulated conflicting crop, rotation, and exclusion instructions.
decision: Retire all directional-face images and regenerate each view from the retained frontal reference with the single compact generator. A generated candidate requires a new human review before registration.
